description: This file defines the AdminUserCreationController class, which extends an abstract installer Vue controller and manages the admin user creation screen in the installer module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AdminUserCreationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the admin user creation step during installation, rendering the appropriate Vue component and managing state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting up the Vue component for the admin user creation screen and updating the current state of the installer.
